limitations: This is a proposed layer-by-role partition, not a default, installed tool census or readiness count.
No repositories or winners are selected before the command center's adoption synthesis.
SDK languages are coverage questions, not availability/installation claims. Coalesce monorepo language/interface roles before finalization when repository ownership would collide.
Practices without a repository require explicit source/owner decisions; never invent repository identities.
Default proof fields link canonical pins, receipts and scoped refutations; a successful overlap check proves declarations only.
